changelog:
Juejin Article Optimizer 1.0.0 — Initial Release

- Analyze and optimize technical articles for Juejin: improve SEO, readability, and engagement.
- Diagnostic scoring across 6 critical dimensions, benchmarked against top Juejin posts.
- Generates high-CTR title variants using proven Juejin patterns.
- Recommends structure, code/text ratio, and visual enhancements for mobile-first readers.
- Provides detailed publishing strategy including best timing, tags, and cross-promotion snippets.
- Supports optimization for new drafts, low-performing published articles, and adaptation of English content for Juejin.
summary: Optimize Juejin technical articles by improving title, structure, code/text ratio, readability, SEO, and engagement for better rankings and reader interaction.
